notes: Unavailable and discontinued SDMX observations remain null, including pre-inception Main Street facility observations.
Pre-2020 other credit facilities are not forced into the current asset breakdown; missing coverage remains N/A.
Table 5 uses Federal Reserve notes net of Bank holdings, not Table 1 currency in circulation.
H.4.1 amounts are rounded to USD millions; 5 million tolerance is used for reported sums.
NY Fed overnight operations may span multiple calendar days on holidays; filter term=Overnight, not termCalenderDays=1.

funding.join: Effective date or operation date equals the H.4.1 Wednesday; no carry-forward
funding.spreads: (SOFR or EFFR minus IORB) × 100 basis points
funding.dailyJoin: Same effective / operation date; no carry-forward; distinct repo operation IDs summed; missing remains null
